study: eBOSS DR16 ELG official maskbit gzip source-byte sampling by preselected middle filename in all four chunk families
sampling_rule: For each of the four official lexicographically sorted SHA-pinned lists, choose names[len(names)//2], exactly one filename per chunk. No resampling or substitutions if a file fails.
network_contract: Official HTTPS approved URL only; GET exactly selected published gzip file; HTTP status 200, Accept-Encoding identity, Content-Length required and bounded, resolved URL unchanged, SHA256 of every raw gzip byte; gzip magic+compression-method prefix check. Record ETag and Last-Modified if present, but do not interpret them as official SHA.
freeze_next: Upload the exact per-file first-seen gzip SHA report and register each checksum in a separate immutable protocol before decompressing even FITS headers or inspecting WCS; no mask pixel interpretation at this byte provenance stage.
